text:
```yaml
name: Update eslint-plugin-sonarjs changelog

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version of eslint-plugin-sonarjs to update changelog for'
        required: true
        type: string
    secrets:
      GITHUB_TOKEN:
        required: true

jobs:
  update-changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run changelog update
        run: "node tools/update-changelog.js ${{ inputs.version }}"

      - name: Check if CHANGELOG.md changed
        id: check-changelog
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet --exit-code CHANGELOG.md; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check-changelog.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "changelog: update for eslint-plugin-sonarjs v${{ inputs.version }}"
          git push origin HEAD:changelog-update-${{ inputs.version }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check-changelog.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "changelog: update for eslint-plugin-sonarjs v${{ inputs.version }}"
          title: "changelog: update for eslint-plugin-sonarjs v${{ inputs.version }}"
          body: |
            Automated changelog update for eslint-plugin-sonarjs v${{ inputs.version }}.
          branch: changelog-update-${{ inputs.version }}
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
